title: AI Event Engagement Platform with Instagram Replies and Vector Search
summary: An end-to-end system that syncs event data, embeds it for semantic search and uses it to answer Instagram comments, with a dashboard to control it all.
headline: AI that answers your audience around the clock
problem: Answering a high volume of audience comments about events took manual effort, and the answers depended on event details that changed often.
solution: I built the ecosystem from three connected parts: automated event ingestion and embeddings, an AI workflow that replies to Instagram comments using retrieval, and a dashboard to monitor and moderate everything.
highlights: Event data synced from Google Sheets to Supabase
Semantic retrieval from a vector store
role: Sole engineer. I designed the architecture and built all three parts.

results.label: Audience questions answered automatically with current event details
